original_title: No breakthrough in ECOWAS talks with Guinea-Bissau coup leaders

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: ECOWAS mediation failure indicates prolonged political instability following military coup. While no immediate violence reported, unresolved leadership disputes create environment conducive to protests, transportation disruptions, and potential targeting of government/logistics assets. Regional diplomatic pressure continues but without clear resolution timeline.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased military presence likely in capital Bissau. Possible protests near government buildings/airports. Cargo operations may experience heightened inspections or temporary closures. No immediate aviation safety threats indicated.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Extended political deadlock probable. Potential for: 1) Escalating civil unrest affecting port/airport operations 2) Opportunistic criminal activity during power vacuum 3) Regional sanctions impacting cargo flows 4) Possible retaliatory actions against international assets if foreign intervention perceived
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Recommend: Heightened alert for personnel in Bissau region. Review emergency evacuation protocols. Monitor airport/port operational status daily. Delay non-essential cargo shipments through Bissau. Implement additional verification for local partner reliability. Coordinate with regional security services for threat updates.
